title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the last session before the Christmas closure, with equities running full hours
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 for this event's initial research (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) — not inherited from the proposal. The 2027 tab is a hidden panel the rendered page drops, so the embedded RSC payload was parsed: node 99 reads verbatim ['Christmas Day', 'Friday, December 24, 2027', 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 23, 2027']. Panel attribution is settled by the US-only run it sits in — node 97 'Veterans Day / Thursday, November 11, 2027', node 98 'Thanksgiving Day / Thursday, November 25, 2027', node 9a 'New Year's Day 2027/2028 / Early Close: Friday, December 31, 2027' — where the Japan panel's cards each carry a 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan' note this run lacks. The full 2027 US early-close set parsed this session is 03-25, 05-28, 07-02, 11-26, 12-23, 12-31. The equity side is the same session's nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetch (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes): the 2027 Christmas Day row reads 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)' with NO footnote marker, and NYSE's four early-close footnotes across 2026/2027/2028 name only 2028-07-03, the three day-after-Thanksgiving dates, and 2026-12-24 — so there is no NYSE early close anywhere in December 2027 and 2027-12-23 is a full 09:30-16:00 session. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's recommendations are advisory to member firms rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research (2026-09-09), shadowing the single proposal `proposals/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23.from-christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24.json`, which was read first and whose schedule facts all reproduced. WHAT THE SESSION IS: Christmas 2027 falls on a Saturday, so NYSE observes it Friday 2027-12-24 and there is NO Christmas Eve half day in 2027 at all — the role of 'last session before the break' falls to a FULL-length Thursday session whose bond side shuts two hours early. MEASURED THIS SESSION (docs/research/events/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23.md legs 3-5), and it is a two-factor decomposition rather than a single finding: session VOLUME tracks the HOURS — within the 18 years whose last pre-Christmas session is a Dec-24 half day, that half day is thinner than the full session immediately before it in 18 of 18 (p = 0.00001, median difference -0.510x) — while |MOVE| tracks the CALENDAR POSITION: the last session before the multi-day gap runs 0.47x-0.65x its trailing-20 median |move| whether truncated or not, against 0.93x for the session before that. So 2027-12-23 is expected THICK-ISH AND CALM (SPY volume median 0.767x over 15 full-variant years, vs 0.367x for the 18 half-day years, Mann-Whitney p = 0.0004; |move| median 0.467x), which is the exact inverse of the day-after-Thanksgiving slot the sibling ledger measured as thin-but-not-calm — and the decomposition PREDICTS that sibling, because the day after Thanksgiving is post-gap, so no positional calm applies to it. SECOND FINDING, from a primary independent of both calendars: Treasury pulled its competitive bidding deadline from 11:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. ET on 30 dates between 2018-12-24 and 2025-12-31, every one of them a SIFMA-recommended early close or an auction rescheduled into a holiday-compressed week — but the practice has NOT appeared once in 2026 (0 of 301 auctions YTD), including on 2026-04-02 and 2026-07-02, both SIFMA early-close Thursdays in exactly this date's configuration. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a recommended early close is not a market-wide halt, `symbols` is empty, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for holiday|christmas|closure|half.?day|early.?close|blackout: the only hits are three unrelated uses of 'seasonality'). HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates', the same imperfect fit the 2027-03-25, 2027-05-28 and 2027-11-26 siblings record. DUPLICATE-ID HAZARD, recorded not resolved: `proposals/bond-market-early-close-2027-12-23.from-thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26.json` describes this same real-world session under a different id; if that lane writes its own canonical file the calendar carries two rows for one event. This lane owns only its own id and never deletes or edits another lane's proposal (#1717). CME was not attempted — cmegroup.com has 403'd this runner in every sibling lane — so what Globex does with rate futures that afternoon is not asserted. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
